$(S).description: Station name (primary macro used in .db files)

$(RRRS).description: Station name (used in .substitutions files, maps to $(S))

$(W).description: PLC word number for analog input

custom_record_types.name: RF Processor
custom_record_types.description: VXI RF Processor module - core signal processing for cavity drive, I/Q modulation, DAC outputs, loop control. Contains DSP for direct/comb feedback loops.

custom_record_types.name: I/Q Amplitude Detector
custom_record_types.description: VXI I/Q and Amplitude Detector module - measures forward, reflected, and cavity probe signals. Provides I, Q, amplitude, phase for each channel.

custom_record_types.name: Arc Interlock Module
custom_record_types.description: VXI Arc Interlock Module - detects arc faults, manages fast shutoff, controls station on/off, filament, solenoid, HVPS enable signals.

custom_record_types.name: Clock Module
custom_record_types.description: VXI Clock Module - generates timing for the RF system including 476 MHz reference, sample clocks, and trigger signals.

custom_record_types.name: Gap Voltage Feedback
custom_record_types.description: VXI Gap Voltage Feedback module - PEP-II hardware not installed in SRF1, but software layer is active for TAXI monitoring and LFB resync fault recovery.

custom_record_types.name: Comb Filter 2
custom_record_types.description: VXI Comb Filter module - PEP-II only, not installed in SRF1.

custom_record_types.name: Comb Filter Module
custom_record_types.description: VXI Comb Filter Module - PEP-II only, not installed in SRF1.

ALLEN_BRADLEY.description: Allen-Bradley PLC adapter and DCM data communication signals.

ANALOG_IO.description: PLC analog input signals - filament voltage/current, solenoid voltage/current, circulator current, vacuum, ion pump, tuner block power supply.

ARC_INTERLOCK.description: Arc Interlock Module (AIM) signals - fast arc detection, station enable/disable, fault latching.

BEAM.description: Beam current and status signals for SPEAR ring.

CAVITY.description: Cavity-level signals - RF power, coupling, cavity strength, frequency offset, tuner stepper motor control, vacuum, temperature, window IR monitoring.

COMB_FILTER.description: Comb Filter module signals - PEP-II only, not active in SPEAR3.

DIGITAL_IO.description: PLC digital I/O signals - module status, non-interlocked binary inputs, HVPS digital status.

FEEDBACK.description: Feedback loop control - DAC loop (tune/on/GFF), direct loop, comb loop, ripple loop, TAXI link status, loop ready events.

HVPS.description: High Voltage Power Supply control and monitoring - contactor logic, voltage control loops, power/perveance calculations, SCR control, DCM table status.

INTERLOCKS.description: Interlock signals - PLC interlocked digital inputs, VXI module interlocks, arc fault detection.

IQA.description: I/Q Amplitude detector signals - phase, power, amplitude calculations, gap voltage derivation, amplitude fault logic, calibration and scaling.

KLYSTRON.description: Klystron monitoring and derived calculations - drive power, forward power, gain, collector power, efficiency, filament power, ripple measurements.

RF_PROCESSOR.description: RF Processor (RFP) module signals - DAC values, coefficients, run mode, RF enable, modulation control, lead compensation.

STATION_CAVITY.description: Per-cavity station signals - tuner loop control, load angle calculations, gap voltage setpoints, cavity calibration, direct/comb loop phase control.

STATION_CONTROL.description: Station-level control and status signals - manages overall station state, reset sequences, fault handling, remote/local control, beam abort status, and DCM communications.

sequencer_programs.description: Calibration sequencer - manages I/Q calibration of comb filter and RF processor coefficients for each cavity.
DAC loop PV definitions - defines all PVs used by the DAC feedback loop (tune/on/GFF drive power ramping).
HVPS voltage loop PV definitions - defines all PVs used by the HVPS voltage feedback loop.
Message handler and TAXI monitoring - handles HVPS reset, filament, solenoid, contactor sequencing, GVF TAXI overflow recovery, LFB resync.
Main station state machine - controls station ON/OFF/RESET/PARK transitions, manages HVPS voltage ramp sequences, RF enable/disable.
Tuner loop PV definitions - defines all PVs used by the cavity tuner position feedback loop.
